instruction: Walk forward across the living room, keeping the white sofa on your left. Continue past the large television and turn right through the doorway ahead. Enter the dining room and stop at the dining table with the chairs.
start_yaw_note: yaw -pi/2 faces +X: living room, white sectional sofa on the left, television on the right wall. Previewed as runs/preview2_obs/p2_a_start_00000_rgb.png before freezing.
target_note: Dining table with chairs, previewed as runs/preview2_obs/p2_e_00004_rgb.png before freezing.
sensor_config_source: scripts/eval/configs/vln_r2r.yaml (640x480, hfov 79, forward 0.25 m, turn 15 deg, tilt 15 deg, depth 0-10 m); model_max_depth 5.0 from habitat_vln_evaluator.py look_down_depth clamp
intrinsic_note: fx = fy = width / (2 tan(hfov/2)) computed by the worker from the frozen sensor config; reported by the sim worker 'info' command.
